title: Linkers (although / so)
note: contrast · result · reason. · Bank 48 · good draft · RUE2 TRANSPLANT 2026-08-25: blocks+intro restored from rue2-grok-v1.0 (James-smoked, quality=good_draft); auto-authored bank superseded.

items.en: I was tired, so I went home.
items.cz: Byl jsem unavený, tak jsem šel domů.
items.gap: I was tired, ____ I went home.
accepts: I was tired, so I went home.

items.en: Although it was raining, we walked.
items.cz: I když pršelo, šli jsme pěšky.
items.gap: ____ it was raining, we walked.
accepts: Although it was raining, we walked.
Even though it was raining, we walked.
Though it was raining, we walked.

items.en: She studied hard. However, she failed.
items.cz: Hodně se učila. Nicméně neuspěla.
items.gap: She studied hard. ____, she failed.
accepts: She studied hard. However, she failed.

items.en: He stayed home because he was ill.
items.cz: Zůstal doma, protože byl nemocný.
items.gap: He stayed home ____ he was ill.
accepts: He stayed home because he was ill.
He stayed home as he was ill.
He stayed home since he was ill.

items.en: Because of the rain, we stayed in.
items.cz: Kvůli dešti jsme zůstali doma.
items.gap: ____ the rain, we stayed in.
accepts: Because of the rain, we stayed in.

items.en: I like tea, but I prefer coffee.
items.cz: Mám rád čaj, ale radši kávu.
items.gap: I like tea, ____ I prefer coffee.
accepts: I like tea, but I prefer coffee.
items.explanation: Linker shows relation: contrast / reason / result / addition.
items.explanation_cz: Spojka ukazuje vztah: kontrast / důvod / výsledek / dodatek.

items.en: Even though it was late, he called.

Although it was late, he called.
Though it was late, he called.

items.en: We left early so that we would catch the train.

accepts: We left early so that we would catch the train.
We left early so we would catch the train.

items.en: He is friendly. On the other hand, he is often late.
items.cz: Je přátelský. Na druhou stranu často chodí pozdě.
items.gap: He is friendly. ____, he is often late.
accepts: He is friendly. On the other hand, he is often late.

items.en: I called her only because of the meeting.
items.cz: Zavolal jsem jí jen kvůli schůzce.
items.gap: I called her only ____ the meeting.
accepts: I called her only because of the meeting.
I called her only due to the meeting.
items.use_prompt: Reason linker · only because of / due to + the meeting

cards.title: although vs however
